title: Core-seconds per request before the CPU port and on the product
description: Eight representative endpoint shapes measured on three samples per side. Every product bar is lower than its pre-port bar. The product bars span 0.2029 core-seconds for a basis-20 inactive next-course read to 0.9296 for a basis-60 inactive recommendation, against 1.9979 and 6.4053 on the pre-port tree.
